id./param/scenario/cs/a_110_cs_100.pack|cs_: "Oh! Look!
"You're safe, both of you.
"Master Rab... Sorry to worry you. We were attacked by Hendrik, but somehow managed to escape.
"So the pursuer was him after all. I had wanted to confirm something with Hendrik, but it seems that's unnecessary now...
"As I thought, we must assume monsters have taken root in today's kingdom of Heliodor.
"Long ago, a glorious kingdom was said to be destroyed by a traitorous minister, a monster in disguise. Its name is...
"Mordegon...!!
"After a long journey, we finally arrived at that name.
"That is an incarnation of evil that has schemed since ancient times. Heliodor is likely in its grip too.
"Listen, {var:1}. For all who live in this world, you must fight Mordegon.
"You were born as the Luminary in this age without a god of evil surely for that purpose.
"...But Mordegon is an unknown, powerful foe cloaked in darkness. We cannot face him without a plan.
"The power of darkness... I've heard something. That something that dispels the power of darkness sleeps within Yggdrasil.
"Just as I thought, sister. We must take {var:1} to Yggdrasil...
"{var:1}, take this branch. This Rainbough was once part of Yggdrasil...
"With the Luminary's power, you might learn something about the road to the Great Tree.
{var:1} received the Rainbough!
"Well? Do you see anything, {var:1}?
But nothing could be seen.
"You can't see anything? Is that branch a fake?! Did that informant feed us false info?!
"After all this buildup... impossible!
"Ho ho ho. Well, it can't be helped. From now on, the princess and I will travel with you and find a way to reach Yggdrasil.
"I'm counting on you, {var:1}.
Rab and Jade joined the party!
